notes.title: Full Marx: idle game AdVenture Capitalist gets a sequel
notes.notes:
Free clicker/idle game (i.e. one of those ones where you combine frantic mouse-bashing with long wait times in order to make pretend money values rise ever higher, followed by a bout of absolute self-loathing) AdVenture Capitalist [official site] temporarily destroyed my life a couple of years ago. I believe it still claims a right to Pip’s soul even to this day. News that it is to receive a sequel, AdVenture Communist, thus strikes terror into my withered and mirthless heart. I’m immediately intrigued by the implied inversion in its title. Will I be able to resist?
… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: AdComm 0.1.6 UPDATE
notes.notes:
Greetings Comrades!

The long awaited update to our glorious Communist simulator is finally upon us! Your patience has been long-suffering but not in vain as we have made many changes to the game and we are eager to hear what you think.

We have made significant changes to the core features and balance of the game, which means that your current progress is no longer compatible with the new version of the game. Everyone will be getting a fresh start on their Communist AdVenture so they can get the full experience of the update we have made. Just like before, any purchases made in the game Shop will be credited forward to your new game.

This update has been focused on a new direction and play experience for the game, along with introducing many of the changes and features you all requested after the last update and bug fixes. There is more content for you to check out so you can dig deeper and build higher than ever before, but the game is far from finished. The team continues to work on building out and lengthening the gameplay. Dedicated Comrades will reach limits in the current content and your feedback will help determine how we build out the rest of your AdVenture, so let us hear it.

Up to now our release schedule has been long and drawn out because of the large scale changes we have been trying with the game - literally rethinking the entire build from week to week. Moving forward, such large changes shouldn’t be necessary and we will be able to focus on your feedback for our next moves as we continue to build out the game. We will keep you posted on what our priorities are and the most popular requests we are pulling from your compiled feedback. The timing of future updates will depend on the scope of what is being worked on but we will do our best to keep you informed as we go.

As always, we thank you for your continued loyalty to Communism and look forward to hearing from you.

Peace, Love and Potatoes,

[b]The AdVenture Communist Team[/b]
